title: Low-Level Design
description: A complete progression from programming foundations to object modeling, design principles, patterns, concurrency, testing and machine-coded case studies.

visibility.note: Foundations are retained and searchable but should be collapsed by default. All core levels remain accessible.

nodes.title: Programming and Computer Science Foundations
nodes.summary: Optional prerequisites: the minimum programming and Java knowledge needed to learn object-oriented design.

nodes.title: Object-Oriented Programming Fundamentals
nodes.summary: Understand objects, responsibilities, state, behavior and relationships before designing larger applications.

nodes.title: Object Modeling and UML
nodes.summary: Translate requirements into domain concepts, object responsibilities, relationships and interaction diagrams.

nodes.title: Design Principles and Design Heuristics
nodes.summary: Evaluate design quality and make deliberate choices about coupling, cohesion, abstraction and change.

nodes.title: Clean Code and Maintainable Design
nodes.summary: Write code that communicates intent, protects invariants and remains easy to change and test.

nodes.title: Design Patterns
nodes.summary: Recognize recurring design problems and choose patterns only when they improve the design.

children.title: When not to use a pattern

nodes.title: Data Structures and Algorithms in LLD
nodes.summary: Choose data structures and algorithms that support object responsibilities and real application behavior.

nodes.title: Application and Domain Modeling
nodes.summary: Model business domains and structure applications into clear, testable responsibilities.

nodes.title: Concurrency and Multithreaded Design
nodes.summary: Design objects and workflows that remain correct when operations execute concurrently.

children.title: Atomic variables and compare and swap

nodes.title: Testing, Debugging and Code Quality
nodes.summary: Verify behavior, isolate dependencies and make designs observable, deterministic and safe to change.

nodes.title: Machine Coding and LLD Interview Methodology
nodes.summary: Turn an open-ended prompt into a working implementation while explaining decisions and trade-offs.

nodes.title: Advanced LLD Case Studies and Design Mastery
nodes.summary: Apply the full toolkit to realistic domains, evolving requirements and production-like constraints.
